fact: A December 2025 policy brief reports Kanifing Municipality implemented a Plus Code addressing system between July 2021 and February 2022, georeferencing 36,000 properties, used for waste management and property tax collection, with no new codes assigned since 2022 for lack of budget.
title: Implementing a Comprehensive Digital Addressing System: A Step-by-Step Guide Inspired by the Experience of Kanifing Municipality, The Gambia
